prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: first-person point-and-click castle exploration game background. Generate ONE full-bleed landscape 1536x1024 image, 3:2. Fine realistic painted environmental concept art of the SAME inhabited medium-sized western fantasy lord's castle, with crisp legible architectural edges and rich but natural material textures. Pale warm-gray limestone ashlar, restrained pointed stone arches, textured dark oak, small aged bronze fittings, muted wine-red textiles where appropriate. Believable well-maintained castle proportions and rigid coherent perspective, refined but modest rather than a royal palace. Standing eye-level camera with natural wide field of view, foreground and middle-distance depth. Soft cool daylight balanced by restrained warm household light where appropriate, calm inhabited atmosphere. No people, readable text, signage, emblems, UI, navigation arrows, hotspot outlines, return-button graphic, watermark, collage, modern objects, excessive bloom or magical effects. The picture must be a finished game environment, not a map or cutaway.
Scene: the castle's WORKING HOUSEHOLD KITCHEN, ground floor. View from just inside the small pointed dark-oak serving door from the dining room; that door is BEHIND the camera and not visible. Spacious practical stone kitchen with a lower dark-oak beamed ceiling, coarse but clean pale warm-gray flagstones, and maintained limestone walls. Along the LEFT wall is a large credible stone cooking hearth with a sloping stone hood, a modest controlled fire and a dark metal pot, shelves with plain earthenware jugs and a few bronze or iron cooking implements. This hearth's appearance must be consistent with the service-corridor glimpse: warm pale stone hood, oak work surface beside it, amber firelight, practical unmarked pottery. A heavy rectangular oak preparation table occupies CENTER LEFT, carrying a wooden board, folded cloth, a basket of vegetables and a small loaf, with free walking space around it. Some enclosed storage and a daylight window complete a clean busy-but-empty household kitchen, no modern plumbing or machinery.
EXACTLY TWO VISIBLE EXITS apart from the unseen entrance behind camera: (1) RIGHT rear wall, around x=73%-89%, y=19%-83%, one OPEN FULL-HEIGHT pointed stone doorway back into the SERVICE CORRIDOR. Through it show only a short stretch of pale stone floor, plain gray walls and dark oak beams, then a bend; no extra doors visible inside. Its simple pointed stone moulding matches the open kitchen doorway seen from the service corridor. (2) BACK WALL LEFT OF CENTER but to the RIGHT of the hearth, around x=40%-56%, y=31%-80%, a SEPARATE smaller but still normal human-height stone doorway with a dark-oak door leaf secured open flush to the side, leading DOWN TO THE CELLAR. Make downward travel unambiguous: the LEVEL KITCHEN FLOOR reaches the visible threshold, then the first THREE straight rectangular stone steps descend away below floor level into a sheltered stairwell. The cellar opening must have upright jambs and a correctly receding lower stair flight, with a small warm wall candle illuminating step edges, not a flat black hole and not stairs that ascend. Any following turn is hidden by a solid return wall. Keep the cellar frame fully exposed and large enough to select on a phone. No worktable, barrel, hanging pan or chair blocks either doorway. Clear separation between hearth, descending cellar opening and service-corridor opening. No third visible doorway, people, cellar visible as a cutaway, dangerous blaze, huge industrial furnace, upper balcony or modern objects.
